name: low-code-no-code
description: Low-Code / No-Code: platforms across the whole spectrum — block-based education tools (Scratch, LEGO, micro:bit), workflow automation (n8n, Zapier, Make, Power Automate), integration and iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato), data pipelines and ETL (Alteryx, Matillion, dbt), app builders (Power Apps, Retool, Airtable, Bubble), RPA, and the AI app-generation wave now reshaping the category — plus how to choose, the governance and escape-hatch problems that bite later, licensing traps, the security evidence, and when to write code instead.
